_comment: Complete schema for Web Service Configuration System. Domain: web_service. Env prefix: WEB. All 10 keys from spec.md. Used by config_system.py: the schema dict returned by get_schema() will be a direct mapping of config key -> {type, default, env_var, description, validation}.

host.description: Hostname or IP address to bind

port.description: TCP port to listen on; must be 2048-49151

request_timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds; must be 1-3600

debug_mode.description: Enable debug mode; accepts true/false, 1/0, yes/no, on/off (case-insensitive)

cors_origins.description: Allowed CORS origins, comma-separated; any string is valid

keep_alive_timeout.description: Keep-alive timeout in seconds; must be 1-300

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS; accepts true/false, 1/0, yes/no, on/off (case-insensitive)
